name: video-art
description: Turn ideas and photographs into finished videos with Claude Code: narrated explainers, animated photo stories, and generative loops — scripted, voiced, scored, captioned and self-reviewed.

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.description: One key for image models (Gemini, GPT Image) and video models (Seedance, Veo, Kling). openrouter.ai/keys. Leave blank if OPENROUTER_API_KEY is already in your shell.

gemini_api_key.title: Gemini API key
gemini_api_key.description: For narration (Gemini TTS). aistudio.google.com/apikey. Leave blank if GEMINI_API_KEY is already set.

elevenlabs_api_key.title: ElevenLabs API key (optional)
elevenlabs_api_key.description: For background music. Leave blank to skip music or if ELEVEN_API / ELEVENLABS_API_KEY is already set.
